product.ta-1600-20.summary: The TA 1600/20 combined the central unit with the first display workstation.
product.ta-1600-20.history: Triumph-Adler offered it as a multipurpose office computer. Configuration I in the manual combined the central unit, display and keyboard, with separate diskette drives and printer.
product.ta-1600-20.technical.configurati: The FDE unit supported two diskettes. The manual shows the twin unit in the minimum configuration of variant I.
product.ta-1600-20.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1600-20.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
